summary: autoloan ships a postinstall + require-time beacon exfiltrating host identifiers to a hardcoded VPS
details: autoloan@1.1.0 is a no-op shim whose index.js exports a Proxy of empty functions and whose only real behavior is a beacon in beacon.cjs. The package declares a postinstall script that runs beacon.cjs, and index.js re-fires the same beacon on require(). The beacon POSTs host identifiers (hostname, install path, process.cwd(), process.version) to the hardcoded URL https://vmi3699893.contaboserver.net:8787/_ah/dc, a Contabo VPS unrelated to any publisher infrastructure, with TLS certificate verification explicitly disabled (rejectUnauthorized:false). The package description 'Compatibility shim' and the Proxy-of-no-ops surface are a cover story: there is no advertised functionality, only the outbound beacon, which fires automatically on npm install and on every require of the package. The shape (inert shim + host-identifier beacon to a hardcoded non-publisher VPS) is consistent with a dependency-confusion or name-squat reconnaissance probe.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
